findings.description: CEI violation: state writes clientBalances[token][client]=0 (line 234) and totalDeposited[token]-=clientStoredBalance (line 235) occur AFTER the external ammAdapter.swap(...) call (line 231), and underlyingToken.safeTransfer(owner(),...) (line 238) follows. Touches the principal-accounting + swap/minOut surface (story-045/046). NOTE: the entry point AYieldStrategy.totalWithdrawal (line 388) carries nonReentrant+onlyOwner+whenNotPaused, so single-contract re-entry is guarded; residual risk is cross-contract / read-of-stale-state via a malicious vault or AMM adapter. Kept for the deduplicator/severity-classifier to weigh against the guard.
findings.notes: Aderyn corroborates ordering concern via non-reentrant-not-first on the base path (AYieldStrategy.sol:388).

findings.description: Strict-equality guard `totalShares == 0 || totalDeposited[token] == 0` used as an early-return. These are exact-zero balance guards (not attacker-griefable mid-values), so the equality itself is benign; flagged because it gates the principal-accounting path and silently returns (no revert) on a zero snapshot, which could mask a mis-booked principal. Kept per scope rule (principal-accounting surface).
findings.notes: Detector confidence High but real impact low — early-return guard, not a rounding/balance equality bug.

findings.description: Local `lastToken` declared uninitialized then assigned inside the path-scan loop (lines 75-79) before the `require(lastToken == tokenOut)` route-validation check (line 80). Likely-benign Slither FP: if every path[i]==address(0) (empty path), lastToken stays 0 and the require enforces tokenOut!=0 already checked at line 70, so an all-zero path reverts. Kept because it sits on the route/minOut configuration surface (bidirectional-route invariant, story-039).
findings.notes: FP-leaning; retained only because route config feeds the swap/minOut path.

findings.description: block.timestamp comparisons drive the two-phase total-withdrawal state machine: currentTime >= initiatedAt + WAITING_PERIOD (772), currentTime <= initiatedAt + TOTAL_DURATION (773), currentTime > initiatedAt + TOTAL_DURATION (780). Per suite policy timestamp findings are NOT dropped — the 24h waiting / 48h execution window is load-bearing. Miner timestamp drift (~12s) is negligible against day-scale windows, so practical risk is low; surfaced for completeness.
findings.notes: Scope-context (AYieldStrategy base, story-046 refactor). Kept per suite time-driven policy; severity-classifier to confirm Low.

findings.description: Swapped(...) event emitted (line 140) after the external router.exchange(...) call (line 138). Event-ordering only — no state mutation after the external call in this adapter. Low impact; on the swap/minOut surface so retained rather than dropped.
findings.notes: Aderyn unused-public-function on swap (line 115) is a separate QA item, not corroboration of reentrancy; corroboration here is only that both tools touch the swap external-call site.

findings.description: abi.encodePacked(constantStringLiteral, _uint256ToString(executableAt)) used only to build a human-readable revert() message (lines 407-414). No hashing, no signature, no decode — the collision detector does not apply here. Classic FP. Retained at low confidence solely because Aderyn ranked it High and it sits in the refactored scope-context file; recommend the deduplicator/severity-classifier discard.
findings.notes: Aderyn-only HIGH that is a benign revert-string concatenation, NOT a security issue. Do not promote.

findings.description: Return value of EnumerableSet add(client)/remove(client) (lines 256, 258) is ignored. Standard EnumerableSet usage; the boolean only reports whether membership changed and is not security-relevant for an owner-only client allowlist. Retained for completeness (corroborated by Aderyn unchecked-return) but low confidence / QA-grade.
findings.notes: Owner-only auth surface; ignoring add/remove return is idiomatic. Likely QA, not H/M.
